I don’t have real‑time weather data built into this chat, but I can give you a quick snapshot of what Hanoi usually looks like around this time of year.

| Month | Typical High (°C) | Typical Low (°C) | Rainfall | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|------------------|----------|-------|
| Jan   | 18–20             | 7–9              | 30 mm    | Cool, dry, clear skies. |
| Feb   | 20–22             | 8–10             | 40 mm    | Still cool, occasional showers. |
| Mar   | 23–26             | 12–14            | 70 mm    | Warm, more rain, humidity rises. |
| Apr   | 27–30             | 16–18            | 120 mm   | Hot, high humidity, frequent showers. |
| May   | 29–32             | 19–21            | 200 mm   | Peak rainy season, hot and humid. |
| Jun   | 30–33             | 21–23            | 250 mm   | Very wet, hot, occasional typhoons. |
| Jul   | 31–34             | 22–24            | 260 mm   | Still wet, hot, typhoon risk. |
| Aug   | 31–34             | 22–24            | 240 mm   | Similar to July, slightly drier. |
| Sep   | 30–33             | 21–23            | 170 mm   | Rain tapers off, still humid. |
| Oct   | 27–30             | 18–20            | 90 mm    | Cooler, less rain, pleasant. |
| Nov   | 22–25             | 13–15            | 50 mm    | Mild, dry, clear skies. |
| Dec   | 18–20             | 8–10             | 30 mm    | Cool, dry, sunny. |

If you’re planning a trip right now, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the Vietnamese Meteorological Department) for the most up‑to‑date forecast. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary for a specific date!
